batches.branch: child session w2-a, one branch per unit PR
batches.one_line_summary: subscriptions 69 rows plus the pkg_plans entitlement function and sp_assign_plan into Lakebase billing on branch mig-p1-w2; unit recon PASS, DEGRADED / official_verdict=false
skill_feedback: Source-side op SQL must schema-qualify every table (ow_billing.plans): OW_BILLING_RO has no synonyms, so an unqualified name fails ORA-00942 mid-run.
Do not apply decimal_round to an op whose projection mixes numbers and text; the harness applies rules per column-set and dies on ConversionSyntax. TO_CHAR both sides and compare as strings.
The guard rejects shell for-loops as it rejects command substitution: an idempotency rerun is two invocations, not a loop.
Oracle DATE - 1 is minus one day: convert to INTERVAL '1 day', not - 1.

batches.branch: child session w2-b, one branch per unit PR
batches.one_line_summary: customer_master 25,000 rows into Lakebase billing, sequence and trigger converted; unit recon PASS, DEGRADED / official_verdict=false
skill_feedback: Backfill inside ALTER TABLE ... DISABLE TRIGGER USER / ENABLE TRIGGER USER, otherwise the converted trg_customer_master_seq rewrites cust_name_upper and row_version_no on load; afterwards setval(seq_customer_master, max(cust_seq_no)+1) so app inserts continue past the backfill.
The pre-PR self-check wants *.recon.json with kind recon-report, which the harness does not emit: re-stamp result.json verbatim (emit_recon_report.py) rather than hand-writing a verdict.

batches.branch: child session w2-c, one branch per unit PR
batches.one_line_summary: entity_attr_value 8,333 rows (EAV, duplicate logical tuples preserved) into Lakebase billing; unit recon PASS, DEGRADED / official_verdict=false
skill_feedback: Explicit-value loads into GENERATED BY DEFAULT identity columns do not advance the sequence; advance it after the load, and only ever forwards.

The target sequence is positioned from migrated rows, not from Oracle LAST_NUMBER (Oracle caches 1,000), so carrying the true position across needs the sequence named in the parent-owned mapping spec.

batches.branch: child session w2-d, one branch per unit PR
batches.one_line_summary: customer_master_hist and subscriptions_hist into Delta silver; both source tables empty, so PASS is an empty-set plus schema assertion, DEGRADED / official_verdict=false
skill_feedback: hist_dt must be converted to UTC explicitly; verified stable under three warehouse session timezones.
Keep one shared DD-MON-YY parse expression matching the 18 wave-0 f_str2dt vectors instead of re-deriving it per unit.
max(hist_id) + row_number() is single-writer-safe only; a durable id must derive from source-change metadata supplied by the parent unit.

batches.branch: child session w2-e, one branch per unit PR
batches.one_line_summary: billing_audit_log into Delta silver plus the paused ow_tp_p1_purge_audit_log job; source empty and the job has never run, DEGRADED / official_verdict=false
skill_feedback: A behaviour check that purges must run only when the probe rows are the whole table, else skip and record untested, so it cannot delete audit rows it did not write.
Databricks returns a workspace folder with a /Workspace prefix that the create call does not accept; normalise it or every rerun creates a duplicate query.
Oracle DATE and bare TIMESTAMP are zoneless: Delta must be TIMESTAMP_NTZ. The generator and the twelve committed mapping specs need regenerating in one parent-owned change.

batches.branch: child session w2-f, one branch per unit PR
batches.one_line_summary: credit_notes 5 rows into Lakebase billing; unit recon PASS, DEGRADED / official_verdict=false
skill_feedback: Oracle sorts VARCHAR2 under NLS_SORT=BINARY; a converted ORDER BY <varchar> only matches on a binary collation. Lakebase ow_tp is C.UTF-8 so wave-3's burn-down order holds; on any other collation the consumer needs COLLATE "C".
Do not CREATE SCHEMA in a unit that only declares a table: a missing prerequisite should fail rather than be created outside the write target.

close_note: Wave 2 halted on the two undeclared write targets the verifier found and was released by a human decision, not by the orchestrator: drop the two empty bronze history tables and declare the billing_audit_log runtime write, then re-run the collision check. Both were done (see undeclared_write_targets_remediation) and the manifest revalidates clean: 27 units, 47 write targets, 5 runtime writes, no collisions. Closing covers scope only. The empty-source and unexercised-job limits below stand and carry into STOP E verbatim: p1-customer-master-hist, p1-subscriptions-hist and p1-billing-audit-log are schema-plus-empty-set assertions whose idempotency reruns prove nothing, and ow_tp_p1_purge_audit_log has zero runs. Wave 2 is not 'all units passed'.
launch_reason: run_workflow was retried once for wave 2 as instructed and failed the same way it failed for wave 1: the process it starts inherits no environment, so DATABRICKS_HOST / DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID / DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET and the AWS pair are absent and the pre-flight factory-doctor fails databricks_identity (the retry got further and then died on ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'recon'). Persisting the credentials to a CLI profile or any file to get past it stays refused. Six child Devin sessions ran the same batch contract instead: manifest and write-target collision check before launch, one PR per unit into the working branch, children write only .migration/recon/<unit>/, the orchestrator is the single writer of these wave artifacts, the same 3-same-class circuit breaker, and an independent verifier that migrated none of the units.
recon_grade_reason: d10_01_denied: Lakehouse Federation to Oracle was refused, so recon reads Oracle over JDBC with a repo-local adapter outside the harness's tested matrix. Every wave-2 verdict is DEGRADED and none is an official harness verdict. Tiers 5-7 stay unverified and merge_eligible is false on every unit.

undeclared_write_targets_remediation.decision: Human decision relayed by the parent: drop the bronze tables, declare the w2-a audit runtime write, re-run the collision check, resume wave 3. The audit write is legacy behaviour the migration is meant to preserve, so it is declared rather than engineered away.

findings: All nine units recomputed from Oracle read-only and from the target platform directly (Lakebase branch mig-p1-w2, Delta ow_tp), never from CDC output the units produced. Data parity is exact: 0 row-count, money-sum, keyed-digest or date-canonicalisation differences.
Type fidelity clean: no float money (numeric(12,2) / decimal), all timestamps zoneless (timestamp(0) / timestamp_ntz), raw DD-MON-YY strings byte-exact beside their parsed companions.

customer_master anomaly set recomputed: 50,000 non-null raw date cells, 50 unparseable, 325,050 expected NULL parsed companions against 325,050 in target, 0 mismatches. entity_attr_value duplicate logical tuples preserved exactly: 187 duplicated tuples / 192 extra rows on both sides.

WRITE-SCOPE BREACH 1 (undeclared target): w2-d created ow_tp.bronze.customer_master_hist and ow_tp.bronze.subscriptions_hist. Both are empty and CREATE TABLE only, and neither appears in the batch's write_targets.

WRITE-SCOPE BREACH 2 (undeclared runtime write): w2-a's sp_assign_plan writes billing.billing_audit_log through log_msg while the batch declares runtime_writes: []. One insert observed, rolled back, 0 live rows.

Three units are empty-source assertions rather than data proofs: customer_master_hist, subscriptions_hist and billing_audit_log are empty at source, so their PASS covers schema and an empty set, and their idempotency reruns are MERGEs over 0 rows.

ow_tp_p1_purge_audit_log exists and is PAUSED with zero runs; Oracle's job is disabled, so the job artifact has never been exercised on either side. The purge WRITE/DELETE commits on silver.billing_audit_log were ad-hoc runs, not the job.
silver.billing_audit_log schema was changed (SET TBLPROPERTIES and two CHANGE COLUMN) after the final MERGE that the unit cites as its merge evidence.

p1-pkg-plans: the Oracle side of the tier-4 op inlines the package body instead of calling pkg_plans, fn_list_plans has no converted counterpart, and the never-invalidated package-global cache is not reproduced (Oracle keeps the previous g_last_plan_code on a swallowed exception; the Postgres function returns NULL).
Oracle FK_SUB_TENANT and FK_SUB_PLAN are enabled and validated at source but absent in Lakebase, disclosed and justified by D8-01 orphan preservation, and still a structural difference.

Idempotency corroborated from Lakebase pg_stat_user_tables (ins/upd/del): subscriptions 71/209/0, customer_master 25000/25000/0, entity_attr_value 8333/33332/0, credit_notes 5/10/0, with wave-1 tables untouched.

Everything above is DEGRADED with official_verdict=false, reason d10_01_denied; none of it is an official Oracle harness verdict. The verifier migrated no unit, wrote to no target, edited no .migration file and opened no PR.
